---
title: "About Key Penang Statistics"
---

Key Penang Statistics is Penang Institute's central data platform providing accessible, reliable and up-to-date statistics on Penang's economy, society and development. It brings together data from authoritative sources through interactive dashboards and concise insights.

The platform serves as a trusted reference for evidence-based policymaking, research and strategic planning, supporting a deeper understanding of Penang's socio-economic landscape, development trends and emerging priorities.
